items.information:
É imprescindível ter lido as regras da WCA.
O competidor poderá se inscrever em quantas modalidades desejar.
Pedimos que não se inscreva nas modalidades que não possui intenção de participar.
3x3x3 Vendado será a modalidade principal desta competição.


You must have read the WCA rules.
The competitor may sign up in as many events he wants.
We ask that you do not sign up for events you do not intend to participate.
3x3x3 Blindfolded is the main event of the competition.

items.name: DSF Generalforsamlingen 2020
items.information:
Dette vil være en officiel WCA konkurrence. Efter konkurrencen vil der blive afholdt den årlige generalforsamling for [DSF](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/DSFGeneralforsamlingen2020#12810-dsf-dansk-speedcubing-forening-danish-speedcubing-association). Mødet er forventet at starte klokken 17:45.

______
In addition to this being an official WCA Competition, the anual meeting of the [DSF](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/DSFGeneralforsamlingen2020#12810-dsf-dansk-speedcubing-forening-danish-speedcubing-association) will be held after the official events of the competition. The expected start of the meeting is 17:45.

items.name: Cult A Way Cube Open 2020

venue.name: Sree Chitra Thirunal College of Engineering
venue.address: Sree Chitra Thirunal College of Engineering, National Highway 66, CTO Colony, Pappanamcode, Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala

items.information:
* Make sure you will be available at the venue at least 15 minutes before your event starts. You won't be allowed to participate in an event if you reach late.
* If you're participating in a WCA competition for first time or not aware of competition rules, make sure that you attend the tutorial session.
* If you're participating in a WCA competition for first time, please bring your ID card as well.
